What if you microwaved food in plastic every day?
Leftovers in plastic tubs are a classic quick lunch. It's super convenient. Lots of containers even say microwave safe.

But here's the twist. Heat can make some plastics release chemicals and tiny particles into your food, so experts say use glass or ceramic instead! Microwave safe usually means the container won't melt, not that nothing leaks into food.
